1922 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
303 days from 12-29-1922:  
December has 31 days, so 2 days left in Dec → goes to 12-31-1922.  
303 - 2 = 301 days left.  
January 1923: 31 days → 301 - 31 = 270 left.  
February 1923: 28 days → 270 - 28 = 242 left.  
March: 31 → 211 left. April: 30 → 181 left. May: 31 → 150 left. June: 30 → 120 left. July: 31 → 89 left. August: 31 → 58 left. September: 30 → 28 left.  
October 1923: 28 days later → October 28, 1923.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1923-10-28
